negative_being_revived.statement: P11D sparse-decoder gap unmet at r=3 (low width) while P11.I high-width cells pass at r>=7; the pooled universal attack prevailed
terminals_touched: P11D gap gates (threshold ratio >=4x, delta64 >=0.20) not met at low width

not: decoder-mechanism limit: the registered L1 universal attack is already at the information boundary at r=3 — an exact hypothesis-free screening decoder with zero learned parameters and zero hyperparameters matches or beats it on every frozen r=3 reading

attack-strength artifact: the compiled defence is already perfect (compiled@64 = 1.0 at every r=3 reading), so no decoder-side upgrade on either side can widen the n=64 gap; the gap gates are unattainable against the capacity-augmented pool by arithmetic, not by solver luck

mechanism.first_order_correlation: rho(r) = C(r-1,(r-1)/2)/2^(r-1), exact by pairwise independence of distinct parity columns; inactive columns have correlation exactly 0
mechanism.support_recovery_requires: n ~ 1/rho(r)^2 samples: recovering WHICH r of the p bank columns are active is marginal screening, and its cost grows with r
mechanism.consequence_at_r3: n* in [36.1, 62.2] < 64 at every registered bank geometry -> the active support is recoverable at the smallest registered train size, so the best universal attack is at target by n=128 and the n=64 gap is bounded by what the support has not yet recovered
mechanism.consequence_at_r7: n* in [92.4, 159.2] in (64, 256) -> the defence window is exactly where P11I found it

lever: capacity branch of the revival doctrine: pre-registered width-conditioned claim with the impossibility argument made precise (proven width bound + capacity-augmented attack pool), rather than a decoder-side mechanism upgrade at low width

retest.replay: two consecutive full runs byte-identical (stdout cmp equal); all 42 frozen readings replayed exactly (7 frozen seeds x 3 r=3 rungs x screening decoder + published pool joins)
retest.capacity_augmented_pool: max(UNIVERSAL_L1, UNIVERSAL_L2, UNIVERSAL_EXTRA_TREES, SPARSE_SCREEN) — strictly stronger than P11H's registered pool

prediction_record.P1_disclosure: screen@64 range at r=3: 0.7255-1.0; the boundary is in (64,128], not below 64; reported as a miss, boundary statement corrected, nothing tuned
prediction_record.P2_content: the no-free-parameter law retrodicts the full P11H 15-rung candidate table, including the rejected rows (r=3 attack-wins, r=5 knife-edge n* in [64.2,110.6] straddling 64/128 -> 'unstable', r=7 defence window)
prediction_record.P3_content: rho closed form validated on frozen test sets: measured active rho within 0.004 of exact; inactive |mean| <= 0.022

retest.correction_disclosed: first-draft Hoeffding certificate wrongly used the range-1 form 2exp(-2 n t^2); for range-2 (plus/minus 1) statistics the correct union bound is n_cert = (8/rho^2)ln(2p/delta) (~338 at p=969, r=3) — a loose sufficient bound only; the load-bearing boundary is the calibrated n_screen law plus exact empirical replay, not the certificate

before_after.before: r=3 adverse outcome read as a bare negative (gap unmet, attack prevailed) with the failure stage unattributed; backlog hypothesis only guessed 'gap is width-conditioned'
before_after.after: r=3 negative is a theorem-shaped capacity fact: both P11D gap gates are unattainable at r=3 against the strongest constructible universal pool (max attainable delta64 = 0.1741 < 0.20; threshold ratio <= 2 < 4); the width law n*(r,p) = 2 ln p / rho(r)^2 explains the entire P11H ladder with no free parameters; and the r=7 positive window is re-verified against a strictly stronger, capacity-augmented attack (max below 256 = 0.9421 < 0.95 over all 21 r=7 readings)
before_after.frozen_bytes_touched: none — P11H/P11I/P11D protocols, receipts and result JSONs are unedited; this receipt reclassifies the interpretation of the r=3 adverse terminal without moving any published number

boundary.construction: majority-of-r of r uniformly drawn active parity columns on a complete C(d,s) parity bank, d in {14,16,17,19}, s in {2,3,4}, r in {3,5,7,9}; train sizes {64,128,256}; bars 0.95 / 0.20 / 4x carried over unedited from P11G/P11H
boundary.width_condition: the impossibility statement is r-conditioned and bank-width-conditioned: at r=5 the law predicts a knife-edge (n* in [64.2, 110.6]) consistent with P11H's rejection of the r=5 rungs as unstable — not claimed either way here
boundary.bank_width_dependence_at_256: at r=7 the narrow banks (14,2)/(14,3) come within screening capacity by 256 (screen@256 = 0.9414-1.0) while (19,3) sits at 0.9033-1.0 across the 7 seeds — the 256-edge of the defence window is bank-width-dependent, so the P11I 'below target before 256' wording remains the operative bound
not_earned: no universal nonlinear lower bound — the impossibility is for the registered gap gates on the registered train-size grid against the capacity-augmented pool
no claim about real agents or learned compilers; construction-synthetic only
r=5 regime deliberately left open (knife-edge; a dedicated study would need its own frozen protocol)
